title: Correct initial velocity
description: Essential: The answer for v₀ must be √(2eU₁/m) or equivalent, derived from work-energy or kinematics.

title: Correct plate length
description: Essential: The final answer for L must be d√(2U₁/U₂) or equivalent, derived from combining horizontal and vertical motions.

title: Apply work-energy theorem
description: Important: Uses work-energy (eU₁ = ½mv₀²) or kinematics to relate acceleration voltage to entry speed.

title: Analyze projectile motion
description: Important: Recognizes horizontal motion is uniform (L = v₀t) and vertical motion is uniformly accelerated (d/2 = ½at²).

title: Correct electric force
description: Important: Uses a = F/m = (eE)/m with E = U₂/d to find vertical acceleration.

title: Simultaneous equation solving
description: Important: Eliminates time t correctly to express L in terms of given parameters.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Checks that final expressions for v₀ and L have correct physical dimensions.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies vertical displacement (e.g., uses d instead of d/2) or confuses acceleration direction.

title: Incorrect force or field
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong expression for electric field (E ≠ U₂) or force (F ≠ eU₂).
